components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action on dark surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:50px; padding:0 22px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; background:var(--paper, #f0efe9); color:var(--ink, #111110); font:680 .92rem Manrope, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #a997ff); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A secondary action that stays inside the dark tonal field.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height:50px; padding:0 22px; border:1px solid rgb(240 239 233 / 28%); border-radius:10px; background:rgb(17 17 16 / 28%); color:#f0efe9; font:680 .92rem Manrope, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { border-color:rgb(240 239 233 / 58%); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a997ff; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A calm dark field with a functional lilac focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:9px; color:#aaa9a2; font:400 .76rem Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:50px; padding:14px 15px; border:1px solid rgb(240 239 233 / 18%); border-radius:10px; background:#111110; color:#f0efe9; font:400 1rem Manrope, sans-serif; outline:none; transition:border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#a997ff; background:#141413; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a997ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Capability Card
components.description: A flat tonal tile for one operational capability.
components.html:
◎

Релизы

Понятный путь от заявки до готовности к отгрузке.
components.css: .ds-capability { width:320px; min-height:250px; padding:28px; border-radius:14px; background:#191918; color:#f0efe9; display:flex; flex-direction:column; font-family:Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-capability-mark { color:#a997ff; font-size:28px; } .ds-capability h3 { margin:auto 0 10px; font-size:1.4rem; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-capability p { margin:0; color:#aaa9a2; line-height:1.55; }

components.name: Editorial Navigation
components.description: A transparent header with quiet anchors and one underlined action.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height:72px; padding:0 32px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid rgb(240 239 233 / 12%); background:#111110; color:#f0efe9; font:400 .875rem Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-nav span { display:flex; gap:30px; } .ds-nav a { color:rgb(240 239 233 / 74%); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#f0efe9; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta { justify-self:end; color:#f0efe9; font-weight:650; border-bottom:1px solid #f0efe9; padding-bottom:3px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a997ff; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: LabelCloud feels like a precisely lit record archive after hours: dark, calm and tactile, with information taking precedence over decoration. The macro vinyl image supplies the music context, while the interface itself remains editorial and operational. The product deliberately rejects chrome, robotic geometry and dense sci-fi dashboards.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal surfaces with warm off-white type.
Oversized, tightly tracked headings and quiet supporting copy.
One rare lilac signal for focus, icons and selected details.
Real music identity assets instead of invented dashboard mockups.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lilac marks interaction or a single meaningful fact; it never becomes a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Statement First Rule
rules.body: Lead a section with one clear sentence; supporting copy stays smaller and quieter.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: Product content stays on the page plane; shadow is reserved for genuinely floating utilities.

dos: Do let one macro music image carry the visual atmosphere.
Do keep copy factual, short and visibly hierarchical.
Do use transforms and opacity for motion and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do preserve warm paper type against near-black surfaces.
donts: Don't add chrome, robots, neon circuitry or transformer-like 3D objects.
Don't turn each section into a bordered card.
Don't add multiple accent colors or decorative gradients.
Don't fabricate client metrics, admin screenshots or product outcomes.
